axis: B. Trend persistence breadth (independent axis, computed here)
definition: share of markets whose 252-session trend sign equals its sign 63 sessions earlier; Trending = breadth above its own expanding median, Range-bound = at or below (median breadth over the evaluated span 0.8269)
label_information_set: breadth measured from closes through session t-1 and compared with the expanding median of every earlier breadth value (min 252 observations); the label for session t is fixed before session t's return exists.
reconciles_to: session counts sum to the 6,523 sessions in outputs/strategy_metrics.csv
note: Months are assigned to the state holding a majority of their sessions, for the monthly columns only; all daily columns use session labels.
